renewal_options: ICC certifications are valid for 3 years. Renewal requires 45 continuing education units (CEUs) within the 3-year period. CEUs can be earned through ICC-approved courses, seminars, and events. Renew through your ICC member account at iccsafe.org.

official_study_resources.title: ICC Certification Exam Study Companions
official_study_resources.notes: ICC publishes official study companions for each exam. Check iccsafe.org for current titles and pricing.

official_study_resources.title: ICC Online Practice Exams
official_study_resources.notes: ICC offers online practice exams; pricing varies by exam.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-23: ICC's combination-designations page still grants the credential - 'A Combination Inspector Designation is automatically granted after a candidate obtains certification in plans examination, residential inspection, and/or commercial inspection in a specific trade. Types Type Combination Inspector R5 Residential Combination Inspector (RCI)* Exam ID/Prerequisite Exam/Certification(s) B1 Residential Building Inspector E1 Residential Electrical Inspector M1 Residential Mechanical Inspector P1 Residential Plumbing Inspector' and 'NOTE: To obtain the Residential Combination Inspector (RCI) Certification, completion of the four Residential Inspector certifications is required.' There is no separate RCI examination; the designation follows from the four prerequisite exams, which ICC sells individually in its store.

credential.label: designation earned by portfolio or interview assessment, not by examination
